description: Defines the MemoryMessageData struct for representing in-memory queue grain events, including stream identification, timing, and payload data.

classes.name: MemoryMessageData
classes.description: Struct representing messages in an in-memory stream, including metadata such as stream ID, sequence number, timestamps, and payload.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate MemoryMessageData with a stream ID and payload, setting the EnqueueTimeUtc to current UTC time.
